overview_description.description: Sudden Coffee is an online retail store that sells instant coffee powder. The company operates an online platform that enables individuals to subscribe a package of a variety of hand-crafted coffee including hot coffee, hot latte, iced coffee, and iced latte. Sudden Coffee was founded by Joshua Zloof and Kalle Freese in 2015 and is based in San Francisco, California.
